fields.name: Container
fields.evidence: Toolkit ctor ecl::container::ExplorationEntry::ExplorationEntry(ID const&, ID const&) at EoCClient.dll+0x294020 stores the first handle at +0; LEGACY_ContainerExplorationSystem::LEGACY_OpenContainerRequest(short const&, ID const& p2, ID const& p3) (EoCClient.dll+0x8C9490) stores p2 at +0, and its caller EoCClient.dll+0xA6EF60 passes the item (checked with ecl::Item::IsContainer) as p2 and the character's handle as p3 (via LEGACY_ToggleContainerRequest, same argument order).

fields.name: Character
fields.evidence: Second ctor argument (+8); the caller passes ecl::Character::GetEntityObjectHandle(this) - the character that opens the container. operator== (EoCClient.dll+0x2AE870) compares both 8-byte halves.
